prompt: We'd like to be able to filter pages by area in Confluence. Please add a --folder-labels flag, off by default: when it's on, every page also gets a label for each folder it sits in below the directory being published, on top of any tags from its front matter. Add a test.
oracle: Any label md2conf makes up by itself should start with md- followed by the words in lower case run together, so a folder called User Guide becomes md-userguide.
